Independent exact-rational matrix reconstruction and symbolic comparisons passed 914 assertions; finite checks are not substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: Exact two-column subset selection has three genuinely competing pair orbits, and the mixed-shore orbit becomes optimal on an entire positive-screening interval precisely from graph parameter n=6 onward. The theorem determines all optimal pairs, screening switching surfaces, and a large-size nonzero mixed-orbit interval without exhaustive O(n²) optimization. It distinguishes trace-optimal Nyström selection from generic kernel bounds and grounded leader selection.
